name: Install a versioned CLI safely

name: Upgrade generated files without losing custom code

expected_outcome: A version-pinned PR includes changes, migration impact, tests, and conflicts without merging itself.

name: Preserve overrides and package extension contracts
preconditions: Application declares supported overrides

name: Reject incompatible or untrusted upgrades

name: Observe application health without exposing internals
preconditions: Application is running

name: Trace requests and business-side failures
preconditions: Telemetry is enabled

name: Detect failed background processing
preconditions: Durable delivery workers are configured
expected_outcome: Backlog age, retries, dead letters, and dependency outages produce actionable signals.

name: Create encrypted application backups
preconditions: Database and backup destination are configured

name: Restore into an isolated target
preconditions: A valid backup and recovery secrets exist
expected_outcome: Restored identity, membership, billing state, and work queues reconcile safely before traffic cutover.

name: Recover an unsuccessful release
preconditions: Prior signed artifact and migration compatibility data exist
expected_outcome: Compatible application rollback restores service without pretending schema or external billing side effects were reverted.

name: Operate within declared availability and cost limits
preconditions: Profile-specific SLO, RPO, RTO and budget are declared
expected_outcome: Observed service and recovery evidence is compared to targets; single-host downtime is disclosed.

name: Rotate secrets and export diagnostic evidence
preconditions: Authorized operator and redaction policy exist
expected_outcome: Rotation preserves service continuity and the export contains no secret values or user data.

name: Discover only eligible MCP tools
preconditions: Configured installation and supported client profile
expected_outcome: Tool discovery follows frozen exposure policy without leaking inaccessible tenant resources.

name: Invoke domain behavior with REST/MCP parity
preconditions: Active membership, scopes and entitlement
expected_outcome: Equivalent inputs produce equivalent domain outcomes and security decisions.

name: Create and manage bounded API keys
preconditions: Interactive authenticated session and key-management permission

name: Reject stale or overpowered keys

expected_outcome: Current membership, owner/resource/scopes and entitlement all apply; keys cannot elevate themselves.

name: Reject proxy boundary bypass

name: Verify independently of proposed patch

name: Promote eligible repair automatically

name: Pause, recover and resume safely

name: Retain private fixes and evidence
